messages:
sam: heads-up, console latency triage from yesterday shows p50 spikes when dashboards and export jobs overlap.
priya: saw that too. graphs show auth rpc counts scaling linearly with tile count.
dylan: current model does per-tile auth checks + full join materialization on same codepath. that multiplies cost.
kevin: suggestion: split responsibilities into a low-latency render surface and a heavy materialize surface. fast surface = short auth path, cached prefixes, no cross-tenant joins.
sam: agree. fast surface should aim for sub-200ms p50 for interactive panels. materialize surface handles correctness and exports async.
priya: important detail: not removing auth, but moving to a route-level capability token for fast surface to avoid N auth RPCs. token would include tenant, role, scope, and expiry.
dylan: tradeoffs: token caching TTL vs stale permissions. need a mechanism to evict tokens when ACLs change.
kevin: we can add a short-lived 'revocation bump' on role changes that increments a counter included in token validation to force refresh.
sam: fallback path? if fast surface can't satisfy a request (cache miss or token too narrow), fall back to materialize. but protect materialize with admission control to prevent overload.
priya: admission control idea: per-tenant budget for fallbacks (default 3% of requests/minute). allow overrides for VIP tenants.
dylan: also add a circuit breaker by materialize queue length and SLA budget window. when tripped, surface returns degraded view instead of blocking.
kevin: telemetry we need: fallback-rate, auth-token-hit-rate, per-tenant materialize-queue-latency, render-p50/p95. add alerts for >1% fallback for top 10 tenants.
sam: ops-bot, please create RFC stub with split surfaces, token shape, fallback rules, and migration plan. link back.
ops-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/console-surface-decomposition-1719998000 — draft added.
priya: token sketch for implementors:
```
{
  "tenant": "t-xyz",
  "role": "viewer",
  "scope": "panel:read",
  "exp": 1719998600,
  "rev": 42,
  "flags": ["no-cross-join"]
}
```
kevin: implementation notes: renderer must enforce post-filtering for fast surface (coarse), and materialize still does full predicate pushdown to comply with compliance tenants.
dylan: migration plan: feature-flag split off by tenant. start with opt-in for 2 low-risk tenants, measure 7 days, then ramp. default stays single surface until stable.
sam: spike owners? priya takes auth token prototype; dylan will add admission-control middleware; kevin does telemetry & alerts; i'll draft rollout runbook.
priya: I'll also prototype token revocation bump service.
dylan: I'll set up a staging replay that simulates concurrent dashboards + 2x export load. need a 4h window to see steady state.
kevin: quick naming proposal so metrics don't confuse: code names console.fast_render and console.materialize. keep telemetry named accordingly.
sam: timeline: 2 week spike, then 1 week canary, then gradual ramp. sync tomorrow 9:30 to review spike artifacts.
ops-bot: Reminder: sync scheduled 09:30 tomorrow in #eng-platform.
